content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies for each Director post.

content_sections.heading: About ICMR
content_sections.text: The Indian Council of Medical Research, headquartered at V. Ramalingaswami Bhavan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029, deals with biomedical and health research in various areas in collaboration with national and international agencies. According to the notice, ICMR works through its Headquarters at New Delhi and 28 Institutes/ Centres and a large number of field stations across the country. The Director posts in this circular head five of these institutes.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Research Areas
content_sections.text: The vacancy circular lists five Director posts. All five share the same pay, qualification and age limit; the area in which the Research & Development experience must have been gained differs from post to post. *The posts of Director, ICMR-NIMR, Dwarka, New Delhi and Director, ICMR-NITM, Belagavi are against lien vacancies and are subject to reversion of the lien holder.

rows.post: Director-National Institute of Malaria Research (NIMR), Dwarka, New Delhi*
Director-National Institute of Traditional Medicine (NITM), Belagavi*
rows.required_r_d_experience_area: Research & Development related to Integrative/ Traditional Medicine

rows.post: Director-Rajendra Memorial National Institute of Health Research (RM NIHR), Patna, Bihar
rows.required_r_d_experience_area: Research & Development related to Communicable Diseases, or Non-Communicable Diseases, or Reproductive Health, or Child Health, or Nutrition

rows.post: Director-National Institute of Health Research (NIHR) North
rows.required_r_d_experience_area: Research & Development related to Communicable Diseases, or Non-Communicable Diseases, or Reproductive Health, or Child Health, or Nutrition

rows.post: Director-National Institute of Health Research (NIHR) South
rows.required_r_d_experience_area: Research & Development related to Communicable Diseases, or Non-Communicable Diseases, or Reproductive Health, or Child Health, or Nutrition

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Citizens. The same essential qualification and experience apply to all five Director posts. MD/MS or equivalent degree recognised by MCI/NMC OR MBBS or equivalent degree recognised by MCI/NMC with MPH from a recognised University OR Master's Degree in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences or MBBS or equivalent degree, recognised by MCI/NMC, with Ph.D. from a recognised University in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences 15 years, which must include: 05 Years in a managerial position and has handled R&D projects independently (viz. PI or Co-PI of Scientific studies, Head of Research Groups/ Centres/ Institutes/ Laboratories), AND 02 Years regular service in the pay matrix level-13-A or 07 Years regular service in the pay matrix level-13, or equivalent as amended from time to time Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences in Govt./ Public sector/ Private Institutions will be admissible, in the area set for each post in the table above. Ph.D. will be considered as 4 years' experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). MD/MS or equivalent to be considered as 3 years' experience. MVSc will be considered as 2 years' experience. MPH/M.Tech/ME will not be considered as any experience. The period spent on obtaining the minimum essential educational qualification shall not count towards experience. For applicants from the private sector or laboratories/ institutions abroad, the Screening Committee shall decide the equivalency of Pay Scale. The qualifications and experience may be relaxed in the case of exceptionally meritorious candidates, with the approval of the President, Governing Council, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing. Scientists from the Central Government or State Government or recognised autonomous organisations of the Central Government or State Government or Research Institutes or Universities who are: Holding an analogous post on regular basis; or Possessing the same essential qualifications and experience prescribed for direct recruits. ICMR Scientists shall not be eligible for appointment on deputation; they shall apply under Direct Recruitment. The age limit for the Director posts is not exceeding 58 years . For appointment by deputation, the maximum age limit shall not exceed 58 years as on the last date of applications. Age relaxation applies as per the existing Government of India instructions. In addition, the age limit may be relaxed for exceptionally meritorious candidates, based on their CVs/experience, with the approval of the President, Governing Council, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All five Director posts are in Level-14 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,44,200-2,18,200) (7th CPC), with usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees. The posts are filled on regular basis, with all India transfer liability under the Council. 5 years, extendable by maximum 5 years, or till superannuation, whichever is earlier. During the tenure as Director, ICMR Scientists shall hold lien on their substantive post at ICMR. ICMR Scientists, on completion of the tenure (including extension, if any) as Director, shall be given the position of Scientist 'G' in any of the Institutes/Centres/HQ of ICMR, till superannuation; pay and allowances shall be protected in accordance with rules. A Non-ICMR Scientist holding the tenure post of Director can be considered for absorption in ICMR as Director's Grade Scientist, i.e., Scientist 'G', subject to availability of vacancy in the scientific cadre, on completion of minimum 5 years of continuous regular service as Director. The tenure of deputation shall be 5 years (extendable maximum by 5 years, only if the incumbent is absorbed in ICMR). The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or other organisation/Department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed 5 years. The Director on deputation can be considered for absorption in ICMR as Director's Grade Scientist, i.e., Scientist G/Head, subject to availability of vacancy in the scientific cadre, on completion of minimum 5 years of continuous regular service as Director. The fee is paid through the online link given in the application form.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply only through online mode on https://recruitment.icmr.org.in . Enclose the self-attested required documents listed below with the online application. Pay the application fee of Rs.1500/- through the online link given in the application form (SC/ST/Women/PwD/EWS candidates are exempted). To apply for more than one Director post, submit a separate online application for each post, with the prescribed fee wherever applicable. Complete the application by 30 November 2026 till 5:30 PM; applications received after the closing date, for whatever reason, are liable to be rejected. Proof of Date of Birth Educational qualifications Experience Certificates issued by Head of Office/ Head of Organization/ Head HR clearly indicating period and dates of service Relevant documents of educational qualification/ specialization/ experience as claimed must be invariably uploaded At the time of personal discussion: a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, for applicants working in Central/ State Government Departments/ Public Sector Undertakings & Govt. funded research agencies

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes selection through shortlisting followed by interview: Initial shortlisting: all candidates who fulfil minimum eligibility in respect of age, essential qualifications and essential experience (wherever required) shall be short-listed. Further shortlisting: if the number of shortlisted candidates is high and it is not possible to call all of them for interview, ICMR shall further shortlist on suitable criteria fixed by the Competent Authority, ICMR. ICMR generally prefers to call candidates with higher experience in the relevant fields or with higher educational qualification, as decided by the Appointing Authority. Interview / personal discussion: shortlisted candidates are called for interview; government and PSU employees must bring the NOC with an undertaking that "the applicant will be relieved within one month of his/her receipt of appointment order".

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Application should be submitted along with the online application fees. Incomplete applications or applications without supportive documents are liable to be rejected. False information or suppression of any material, noticed at any time during the recruitment process or thereafter, makes candidature/services liable to be terminated. Any outside influence (political or otherwise) brought in by a candidate shall disqualify him/her. Any further detail/ communication shall be displayed on the ICMR website only. ICMR retains the liberty to either modify or cancel or publish afresh this vacancy circular; matters with no specific instruction shall be decided by ICMR. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be under the jurisdiction of Courts in New Delhi. For technical support or payment queries, call 011-26589167 or email [email protected] on working days between 9:30 AM and 5:30 PM (IST).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR Director posts?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted up to 30 November 2026 till 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for the ICMR Director post?
faq.answer: MD/MS or equivalent recognised by MCI/NMC, or MBBS with MPH, or a Master's Degree in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences or MBBS with Ph.D. in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences, along with 15 years' experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for ICMR Director recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 58 years; for deputation it is 58 years as on the last date of applications, with relaxation as per Government of India instructions and for exceptionally meritorious candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an ICMR Director?
faq.answer: The post is in Level-14 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,44,200-2,18,200) (7th CPC), with usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the ICMR Director posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1500/- (non-refundable), paid through the online link in the application form; SC/ST/Women/PwD/EWS candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply only online on https://recruitment.icmr.org.in, enclosing self-attested proof of date of birth, educational qualifications and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q7. How will ICMR select the Directors?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are shortlisted, ICMR may shortlist further if numbers are high, and shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ICMR Director post permanent?
faq.answer: It is a tenure post of 5 years; for direct recruits it is extendable by maximum 5 years or till superannuation, whichever is earlier, and for deputationists it is extendable by 5 years only if absorbed in ICMR.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one ICMR Director post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate online application must be submitted for each post, along with the prescribed application fee wherever applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Can ICMR Scientists apply on deputation?
faq.answer: No. ICMR Scientists are not eligible for appointment on deputation and must apply under Direct Recruitment.
